name: Green Scale Shield
author: voodoo573
description:
Uncommon armor from Level Up: Advanced 5th Edition. While you hold this shield, you have resistance to poison damage.

Hearth does not apply item resistances yet: track the poison resistance by hand until the app supports it.
summary: Uncommon shield that grants resistance to poison damage while held.
